brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
LNG Canada joint venture could approve Phase 2 capacity-doubling expansion by early October. [1]
Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces 'rupture'. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR CANADA
Canada's call for stronger partnerships amid global 'rupture' is underscored by its link to 41 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [2][E2]

KEY RISKS
Canada's link to 41 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations could create diplomatic or economic friction. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the LNG Canada joint venture will approve Phase 2 capacity-doubling expansion by early October. [1]
Whether the US-Canada diplomatic agreement to lower tariffs by October 31 will materialize, given the 18% market price. [E6]
